seoTitle: 👄 Mouth Emoji Meaning - What Does 👄 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the mouth emoji 👄 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 👄 Mouth emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a pair of red full lips, presented front-on. The visual cue reads instantly as beauty-coded reference, kissing default, or the visible 'spill the tea' tag. By 2026 👄 has become the go-to emoji for the lips-coded reaction, the visible gossip default, and the flirty-kiss-coded reaction in close-friends and family chats.

In modern chat 👄 does very specific work. People send it as a literal lips-coded reference, as the visible 'spill the tea' tag, or as the gossip-coded default. The red full lips are the visual cue that the read is flirty-coded. Writers should pick 👄 when the read is beauty/gossip or visible 'tell me more' energy, and avoid it when the read is full-on kiss — 😘 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👄 lands on a friend's gossip message, in a work channel where someone is signaling gossip-coded energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is signaling flirty lips. The red full lips anchor the read.

In close-friends chats 👄 reads as the universal gossip default and the visible 'spill the tea' tag. On X the emoji punctuates tea-spilling-coded and flirty tweets. The emoji pairs with 🍵 for the layered gossip-and-tea stack and with 💋 for the layered gossip-and-kiss stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 👄 in any context where the read is just lips mention. The red lips imply beauty-coded or gossip-coded, not just any mouth. Avoid 👄 in formal contexts where the flirty-coded read lands as unprofessional.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 👄 on a gossip-coded message, mirror with another 👄 or 🍵 to send matching energy. The tea-spilling chain reads as solidarity.

If 👄 lands as the flirty default, reply with another 👄 or 💋. And if you want to send 👄 yourself, pair it with the moment so the gossip-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 👄 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 👄 means beauty-coded reference, gossip energy, or the visible 'spill the tea' reaction. The red full lips are the visual cue that the read is flirty-coded.

faqs.question: Is 👄 flirty?
faqs.answer: Yes. 👄 reads as flirty-coded in a dating thread as a kiss-coded tag or beauty-coded compliment.

faqs.question: What does 👄 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 👄 carries the same gossip-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 👄 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok, 👄 is the default comment reaction to gossip-coded and tea-spilling clips.
